mapper.insert: MERGE INTO byai.byai_super_agent_capability_cards target USING ( SELECT CAST(#{entity.systemCode} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS system_code, CAST(#{entity.agentId} AS VARCHAR(200)) AS agent_id, CAST(#{entity.agentCode} AS VARCHAR(128)) AS agent_code, CAST(#{entity.agentName} AS VARCHAR(200)) AS agent_name, CAST(#{entity.schemaVersion} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS schema_version, CAST(#{entity.generatorVersion} AS VARCHAR(32)) AS generator_version, CAST(#{entity.sourceVersion} AS VARCHAR(128)) AS source_version, CAST(#{entity.sourceFingerprint} AS VARCHAR(128)) AS source_fingerprint, CAST(#{entity.card} AS TEXT) AS card, CAST(#{entity.routingText} AS VARCHAR(1024)) AS routing_text, CAST(#{entity.quality} AS TEXT) AS quality, COALESCE(CAST(#{entity.status} AS VARCHAR(16)), 'ACTIVE') AS status, COALESCE(CAST(#{entity.createdAt} AS TIMESTAMP), NOW()) AS created_at, COALESCE(CAST(#{entity.updatedAt} AS TIMESTAMP), NOW()) AS updated_at ) source ON (target.system_code = source.system_code AND target.agent_id = source.agent_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET agent_code = source.agent_code, agent_name = source.agent_name, schema_version = source.schema_version, generator_version = source.generator_version, source_version = source.source_version, source_fingerprint = source.source_fingerprint, card = source.card, routing_text = source.routing_text, quality = source.quality, status = 'ACTIVE', version = target.version + 1, updated_at = source.updated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (system_code, agent_id, agent_code, agent_name, schema_version, generator_version, source_version, source_fingerprint, card, routing_text, quality, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (source.system_code, source.agent_id, source.agent_code, source.agent_name, source.schema_version, source.generator_version, source.source_version, source.source_fingerprint, source.card, source.routing_text, source.quality, source.status, 0, source.created_at, source.updated_at)
